model: The daily recommendation popup faded its full-screen scrim for 300ms. On small screens the card started transparent and faded for 500ms. On desktop it slid in for 500ms. The scrim and card now appear in one frame.

noise.rule: 18 is round(300ms * 60fps / 1000). 30 is round(500ms * 60fps / 1000). Not a sampled compositor trace.
